name: Multistep Form Framework Examples
project_description: Development examples submodule of Multistep Form Framework. It demonstrates the framework end to end with a four-step "buy a book" wizard: a YAML wizard definition (multistep_form_framework_examples.multistep_wizard.yml) with ajax enabled, a MultistepForm subclass (BookBuyMultistepForm), a Wizard subclass that holds a node across steps (BookWizard), and four step classes (Greetings, BookAttributes, Description, Congratulation) that render real entity-field widgets, jump between steps, and save a 'book' node. It also ships the 'book' content type and its fields as optional config. This submodule is example/reference code and is not intended to be enabled on production sites.
